column.name: alias_name
column.description: Denormalized copy of the scope's canonical alias name -- avoids re-deriving it from (source_identifier, store_name) for display/filtering.

column.name: status
column.description: SearchIndexAliasConfig::STATUS_* -- idle, building, ready, flipping, flipped, aborted, failed.

column.name: flip_pending
column.description: Operator-set intent: 'flip this READY rollout the next time search-index-alias:deploy-flip runs' (the deploy pipeline's SPRYKER_HOOK_AFTER_DEPLOY hook), instead of flipping immediately from the GUI/console. Only meaningful while status=ready; cleared on any status transition away from ready (flip, abort, or a fresh rebuild superseding it).

column.name: live_index_name
column.description: The physical index this rollout considered live at BUILDING start.

column.name: target_index_name
column.description: Set once BUILDING creates the target index.

column.name: mirror_queue_name
column.description: Set for the lifetime of BUILDING/READY, unset (and the queue deleted) once FLIPPED/ABORTED.

column.name: mapping_diff_classification
column.description: SearchIndexAliasConfig::MAPPING_DIFF_* -- additive, breaking, or none. Set once, at BUILDING start, by MappingDiffClassifier -- see README for why misclassifying this is a silent, permanent-damage risk.

column.name: mapping_diff_added_fields
column.description: JSON array of added field paths.

column.name: mapping_diff_breaking_fields
column.description: JSON array of retyped/removed field paths.

column.name: expected_document_count
column.description: Set once BUILDING's bulk load completes -- the count the mirror-queue-drain convergence loop targets.

column.name: finished_at
column.description: Set on any terminal status (flipped, aborted, failed).

column.name: triggered_by_user
column.description: Zed username/email for a GUI-triggered rollout, or a fixed marker (e.g. 'console', 'cron') for a non-interactive one. Null for a rollout the installer plugin created during setup.

column.name: outcome
column.description: Short human-readable summary, e.g. flipped to the new index, or aborted: mapping diff classified as breaking. Distinct from status (a fixed enum) and failure_reason (full error detail) -- this is what a history table row shows at a glance.

column.name: alias_name
column.description: Denormalized copy of the scope's canonical alias name, same rationale as spy_search_index_rollout's own column: avoids re-deriving it from (source_identifier, store_name) for display.

column.name: target_index_name
column.description: The already-existing physical index to atomically switch the alias to on the next deploy-flip run.

column.name: alias_name
column.description: Denormalized copy of the scope's canonical alias name, same rationale as the other two tables' own column.

column.name: index_name
column.description: The physical index that was deleted.

column.name: triggered_by_user
column.description: Zed username/email for a GUI-triggered delete, or a fixed marker (e.g. 'console') for search-index-alias:prune's non-interactive bulk deletes.
